entry_authority.scientific_revision: Fresh design after F8R2 structural failure;retains the fixed-eight hybrid-continuation hypothesis and adds complete passive action/chance accounting.

claim_scope.estimand: theta=(1/8)*sum_r E[d_ri | frozen public root r,frozen source-actor hole r],where d is ensemble-root minus canonical-H11-root payoff for the root actor and both arms share H11-P256 for at most eight post-root decisions followed by passive exact closure.
claim_scope.primary_gate: Unrounded one-sided fixed-root Welch-Satterthwaite 95% LCB(theta)>=+0.20 big blinds per reached root.
claim_scope.no_quick5k_reason: No deployable checkpoint or official greedy-direct policy is created.

rng_probability_and_lanes.rng: SHA256 counter RNG over identity|domain|fields|counter;big-endian first8;open01=(u64+0.5)/2^64;bounded integers use rejection;all census,solver,E0,E1 domains are disjoint and raw keys retained.
rng_probability_and_lanes.probability: One LEGAL_LOGITS_CPU_F64_CDF_V1 routine:float32 logit row copied to CPU;legal logits cast float64,subtract legal max,exp,divide by float64 sum;illegal mass0;slot-order CDF;force final legal CDF1;sample first CDF strictly greater than open01.
rng_probability_and_lanes.canonical: Root/belief H11 uses fixed contiguous batch256 chunks;duplicate only final real row for padding and discard padding.
rng_probability_and_lanes.leaf: H11-P256 uses permanent512 lanes,two batch256 chunks,no compaction,profile-independent mapping physical=(logical+73*t) mod512.
rng_probability_and_lanes.lane_balance: With2,048 iterations every logical lane occupies every physical position exactly4 times.
rng_probability_and_lanes.pairing: E0/E1 use separate profile passes;same tape retains opponent hole,sealed deck,root uniform,ordinal uniforms and lane;profile is excluded from RNG and lane keys.

root_census_and_belief.selection: Preassign one cell per hand;within hand keep the smallest eligible public-only digest;between hands keep the smallest in each cell;all selected roots use distinct hands;missing,duplicate or invalid root is terminal NONPASS with no replacement.
root_census_and_belief.eligibility: Nonterminal exact public state,at least two legal nonnull V5.5 slots,complete exact-cent public history,no seventh same-street action;selection excludes holes,outcome,reward,probability and solver output.
root_census_and_belief.joint_target: mu(h0,h1) proportional to uniform ordered disjoint-hole prior times all chronological canonical-H11 observed-action likelihoods;CPU-f64 logsumexp;never multiply marginals.
root_census_and_belief.source_hole: Frozen only after public selection;positive marginal required;never influences public selection or alternative-hole likelihoods.

proposal.source_event: A={root actor own hole equals frozen source hole}

solver.update: Freeze sigma_t;sample independent traverser0/1 paths from full q;enumerate traverser legal slots;collect both delta tables;then apply R=max(0,R+w*(y_a-sum sigma*y)) simultaneously.
solver.root_average: Before each update S+=t*sigma_t,D=2048*2049/2=2098176;one stream per replica;candidate=.5*(A endpoint+B endpoint).

hybrid_continuation.cap_scope: Count post-root H11-P256 player actions;root action excluded.
hybrid_continuation.passive_trigger: Before a ninth H11-P256 decision or before another H11 observation would require a seventh same-street action.
hybrid_continuation.passive_actions: No further network query. Facing wager call min(to_call,stack),including legal short all-in;otherwise check. Never fold,bet or raise.
hybrid_continuation.chance: Use the tape's presealed uniform remaining-deck permutation;deal exact future cards without replacement;all-in runs out;otherwise check through streets.
hybrid_continuation.terminal: Resolve every outstanding wager before street advance;continue to exact fold/all-in/river-showdown terminal;refund unmatched excess and produce exact-cent zero-sum payoff.
hybrid_continuation.trace: Record trigger reason,all passive actions,chance cards,legality,commitments,terminal class,payoff and trace hash.
hybrid_continuation.fallback_event: Count once per outcome;report CAP8 and HISTORY_OVERFLOW separately.

E0.conditional_deal: Fix source actor hole and sample opponent hole directly from mu(.|source hole),never q;sample future cards without replacement.
E0.candidate_freeze: Ensemble=.5*(replica A+replica B) is frozen before E0 and cannot be selected or changed using E0.

E1.sealed_before_solver: Manifest bytes and SHA exist before solver/E0 and are inaccessible to both processes.
E1.open_condition: Fresh process binds immutable replicas,ensemble,E0 raw hashes and unopened E1 manifest SHA.
E1.primary_gate: Unrounded analytic LCB>=0.20 big blinds per reached root.
E1.no_adaptation: No top-up,reopen,candidate change,root change or reuse.
E1.raw_rows: Create-new rows bind identity,phase,root,tape,actor,opponent hole,sealed deck hash,arm,root uniform/slot,ordinal RNG hashes,lane,network count,fallback reason/passive trace,terminal payoff cents and paired difference.

analytic_confidence.root_statistics: In fixed root order use binary64 mean_r and sample variance s_r^2 with ddof=1.
analytic_confidence.degenerate: If V exactly0,all differences and pairing gates must be finite/valid;set df=positive infinity and LCB=theta. Otherwise denominator and df must be finite and positive.
analytic_confidence.sample_sizes: n_r=2048 for E0 and4096 for E1.
analytic_confidence.scope: Roots are fixed strata and never resampled;candidate fixed;solver randomness excluded;one E1 primary quantity.

resource_admission.position: After fresh implementation and independent implementation-audit PASS;before any census,root,belief,solver or evaluation row.
resource_admission.performance_probe: Use frozen F8R1C1 eight-block minimum rates and fixed costs;no new performance measurement.

padding_envelope.purpose: Resource-only duplicate-E0/E1 padding;must never create extra scientific profiles,tapes or rows.

implementation_audit_and_judgment.fresh_runtime_graph: fresh exact-cent engine->strict H11 loader/encoder->canonical census/belief->MCCFR+->P256-cap8/passive closure->E0->candidate freeze->sealed E1->exclusive evidence
implementation_audit_and_judgment.preimplementation_audit: Independently recompute identity,input hashes,exact formulas,passive bounds,resource projection,inference and path absence.
implementation_audit_and_judgment.implementation_audit: Execute independent no-model exact-cent,RNG,probability,tiny-MCCFR+,lane,passive termination/legality,paired inference,E0/E1 isolation and count oracles before resource admission.
implementation_audit_and_judgment.result_audit: Independently rehash and recompute every raw payoff,difference,count,fallback denominator,mean,variance,df,t critical,LCB,resource and integrity gate.
implementation_audit_and_judgment.exclusive_outputs: Create-new only;no overwrite,latest pointer,reconstruction from missing raw evidence or mutation of frozen attempts.
implementation_audit_and_judgment.rollback: H11 remains the only official policy.
implementation_audit_and_judgment.route_effect: PASS authorizes only a separately registered broader teacher design;NONPASS reranks but alone does not exhaust the family.
